senses.gloss: m. (שרק, v. סָרַק II, cmp. Syr. סרוקא P. Sm. 2750) stripe, streak.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 74b:12">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ דדמא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>שׁוּרְיָיקֵי דמא</he>) a streak (streaks) of blood.—Pl. <cite ref="U00548"><he>שׁוּרְיָיקֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 4b">Ab. Zar. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ סומקי</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <cite ref="O00001"><he>ס׳</he></cite>) red stripes (in the white crest of a cock); <cite ref="Sanhedrin 105b:8">Snh. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>סוּרְיָקֵי</he> (some ed. <he>סִרְיָקֵי</he>; Ms. M. <cite ref="U01985"><he>שִׁרְיָקֵי</he></cite>; Ms. O. <he>שוריקי</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 300">Yalk. Is. 300</cite> <he>שוריי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 47b:15">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ חיורי</he> white stripes or shreds.

<cite ref="Chullin 93b:4">Ib. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ סומקי</he> red veins; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b:13">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ סומקי</he> (Ms. M. <he>סוריקי</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 668:2">Yalk. Ps. 668</cite> <he>סוריקי</he>, a. <he>סורקי</he>.
